lines.text: Zion's righteousness will shine like a bright light, nations will see it, and she will be a crown in the LORD's hand.
Zion will no longer be called Forsaken but Hephzibah, and her land Beulah, because the LORD delights in her.
Watchmen are posted on the walls of Samaria, and those who call on the LORD give Him no rest until He establishes Jerusalem.
The LORD swears that foreigners will never again drink Zion's wine, and the people are told to raise a banner for the kings.

wrong_details.wrong: raise a banner for the kings
wrong_details.true: raise a banner for the nations

lines.text: The LORD proclaims to the ends of the earth that Zion's Savior comes, and she will be called Sought Out.
